summary: The Hamilton City Hall defund-police encampment is documented through a City notice dated 30 November, with >75-person crowds on several occasions during the prior week. CIVICUS later reports tent removal at the City Hall defund-police protest on 30 December and says the demonstration had been week-long. Same venue/campaign suggests a possible later continuation, but seamless continuity across the month is not established. No new December event is created pending episode resolution.
open_questions: Find a contemporaneous report for 30 December and compare organizer/attendance/site status; determine if a new action or same camp.
